description:
The second arm of the ordered blank-field chain, app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:123-127, and the only case in this folder that can prove that arm is reached at all. EVALUATE TRUE at :117 is ordered, so the second WHEN is evaluated only when the first did not match: USERIDI carries the real key ADMIN002, so :118 WHEN USERIDI OF COSGN0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES is false, and :123 WHEN PASSWDI OF COSGN0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES then matches on a PASSWDI of eight spaces. :124 moves 'Y' into WS-ERR-FLG, :125 moves 'Please enter Password ...' - twenty-five characters - into WS-MESSAGE, :126 moves -1 into PASSWDL, and :127 performs SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN.

What must not happen is as much of the assertion as what must. 'Please enter User ID ...' is absent from every expectation here, and there is no cursor request on USERIDL: cursorField is PASSWDL and nothing else, because a screen carries one cursor and :126 is the only MOVE -1 on this path. The three blank-field cases divide the ordered chain between them and none of them is redundant. case06 supplies a blank user id and a real password, which pins the first arm. case08 transmits neither field, so both arrive as LOW-VALUES and both WHENs would match, which pins that the earlier arm wins and the later one is never evaluated. This case supplies a real user id and a blank password, which is the only configuration that reaches :123 at all - so it alone would catch an implementation that shadowed the second arm behind the first, folded the two tests into one, or never wrote the second arm. Reordering the two WHENs or accumulating both messages is caught by case08; losing or short-circuiting the second arm is caught only here. That is why this case exists, and why its user id must stay non-blank if it is to prove anything about the ordering.

The error flag is raised before the screen is painted, and :132-136 then run UNCONDITIONALLY because they sit after END-EVALUATE at :130 and outside every arm of it: MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(USERIDI OF COSGN0AI) TO WS-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-ID and MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(PASSWDI OF COSGN0AI) TO WS-USER-PWD. So the navigation area carries CDEMO-USER-ID as ADMIN002 even though the sign-on was rejected, which is exactly the detail a translation tidies away by folding the normalisation into the success path. It is asserted here rather than assumed. Only CDEMO-USER-ID is touched: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, CDEMO-USER-TYPE and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT are set only on the success path at :221-228 and arrive back unchanged, and nextProgram is absent because no XCTL is reached. :138 then finds ERR-FLG-ON, so PERFORM READ-USER-SEC-FILE at :139 is skipped entirely and the ten seeded rows are never read - the key typed here is never looked up.

USRSEC is seeded from app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose ten in-stream rows are 57 characters where app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy declares 80: SEC-USR-ID X(08) at 0, SEC-USR-FNAME X(20) at 8, SEC-USR-LNAME X(20) at 28, SEC-USR-PWD X(08) at 48, SEC-USR-TYPE X(01) at 56 - which is 57 - then SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) at 57, which is 80. The 23-byte shortfall is supplied once at seed time by the declared USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation and never hand-padded, and the 80-character expectedFinalState images prove that span was emitted as 23 spaces - a record missing it would be short by exactly 23. The same job corroborates the target width twice, with DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) on SYSUT2 and RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) on the cluster. The dataset is addressed by its binding key USRSEC - the CICS file name at :39 - and never by a dataset name. expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion: COSGN00C contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE on any path, and the read at :211-219 does not even specify UPDATE, so it takes no lock and holds no record. expectedFinalState is therefore the pre-state unchanged, row for row, which is the assertion a rejection path needs to make. expectedReturnCode is 0 because grep -c RETURN-CODE over the program is 0.

Determinism and the two substitutions. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO opens with MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :179, so the clock is pinned rather than read: 2022-07-19T23:12:33, traceable to this program's own version footer at :259 and expressed as a fixed local date-time so no timezone can shift it. Through app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY is MM '/' DD '/' YY with YY taken from WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2), giving CURDATEO exactly 07/19/22 at its PIC X(8); WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS is HH ':' MM ':' SS, eight bytes, moved into CURTIMEO which app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY:122 declares PIC X(9) - hence 23:12:33 followed by exactly one trailing space. Note that width: the sibling COUSR02 map declares its CURTIMEO PIC X(8) and the two must not be conflated. APPLID and SYSID come from EXEC CICS ASSIGN at :198-204, which has no Java equivalent and which neither application.yml nor application-test.yml binds, so CICSAWS1 and AWS1 space-padded to PIC X(8) are pinned constants standing in for those two calls; all twenty cases use the same pair, and the substitution is stated rather than hidden. The charset is named US-ASCII explicitly and is never the platform default.

Two deviations are recorded rather than quietly worked around. First, app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:59 reads *COPY DFHATTR. with the asterisk in column 7, which makes it a COBOL comment: the copybook is not in effect, so no DFHATTR attribute constant applies to this program, notwithstanding that it is counted as one of that copybook's two consumers. Second, COSGN00C never copies CSSETATY - grep -c CSSETATY over the program is 0 - so there is no runtime DFHRED plus '*' field highlight of the kind COACTUPC applies at thirty-nine sites. The emphasis on this screen is entirely static: app/bms/COSGN00.bms:197-200 declares ERRMSG with ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) and COLOR=RED at LENGTH=78, so the map itself carries the colour and the brightness. That is why the attributes map of the send is empty, and the emptiness is a positive assertion rather than an omission - a CSSETATY-style implementation would have moved an attribute byte onto the offending field, and on this path nothing of the sort happens. The single -1 cursor request is the whole of the runtime emphasis.

Provenance. Every expected value above is statically derived - by structured reading of app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy for the record layout, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the communication area, whose fields sum to the 160 bytes this case declares as EIBCALEN, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy for the literals and the header, app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY with app/bms/COSGN00.bms for the screen field shapes, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD for transaction CC00, and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 for the ten seed rows. Note that COTTL01Y line 21 is commented out, so the active CCDA-TITLE02 is line 22 and TITLE02O carries CardDemo rather than the older Credit Card Demo Application text. It was never captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand.

The unit is SignOnService, driven as a plain object with a fixture-backed SecUserRepository, and the eleven-field screen is projected by SignOnController, also a plain object - no MockMvc, no HTTP, no servlet container and no JobLauncher in the path. All conversation state travels in the payload, so no server-side session exists to hold any of it. The password stays plaintext because app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:223 compares it in plaintext; that is an inherited property of the legacy design and an explicit non-goal of this migration, not something to correct here, and no hash, token or encoder appears anywhere in this case. Neither the backward-GO TO restructuring gate nor the abend gate applies: grep -c "GO TO" and grep -c CEE3ABD over app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl are both 0, and neither is faked. No file operation is reached on this path, so no file-status outcome is exercised either.
